scope: Exact stock QQ dense LU; bounded exact QQ/ZZ Risch polynomial_reduce; read-only cold LLL rejection and bootstrap/reimport protocol corrections, preserving complete fallbacks.

source_identity.scope: Code, tests, audit fixtures, package configuration and native binary; documentation excluded

rust.validation_mode: Fresh complete execution on345 native inputs, no earlier native result reuse.

LLL.private_rust_reuse: Two-Python-file getter followup reuses native341-input check/clippy after independent path/hash/binary equality; all integrated native tests above rerun fresh.

private_validation.Risch: Ordered primary, reload and serializer-origin followups with their independent raw logs and manifests are retained in the component archive. Final counts are recorded by the delivered component final-validation reports.

repairs: LU executes actual length/dimension prefix, passes actual range/min dependencies and preserves per-step scalar publication/swaps/aliases; unsupported protocols resume below that prefix without replay.

LLL read-only cold probe neither classifies nor mutates ABC caches. It rejects known cold state before expensive proof work. Origin authentication precedes captured aliases/getters; removed/reimported module namespaces cannot reuse stale proofs. Cold mathematics remains the complete old algorithm.

Risch keeps the actual zero-Poly constructor prefix, independently checks live tp_new against the immutable PyClass table, and preserves domain/polynomial identity conventions. Stock verifier reload authenticates full code graph and environment without blessing callbacks. A second Python followup authenticates the marshal delegate and never invokes a foreign serializer.
remaining_gaps: Global mathematical parity is not certified.
LU native scalar elimination admits stock QQ only. Split/triangular solves, other domains and custom/aliased rows retain their complete established paths. Full lu_solve is not claimed ported.
LLL genuinely cold calls retain Python mathematics; only a safe cheap rejection is added here. First/repeated performance is measured separately, not inferred from native helper use.

Risch polynomial_reduce admits bounded univariate QQ/ZZ polynomials and audited rational polynomial derivation towers, degree<=256/coefficientbits<=4096. Other domains, noncanonical constructors/functions, derivations/options and resource refusal resume the complete prior driver. This does not port the whole Risch/PRDE/integrator.
Previous symbolic-derivative, RootSum/general-integration, domains/precision/completeness and resource gaps remain explicit.
Risch zero/no-step dispatch regresses to roughly770–1054us and is under correction; no such cases are omitted from release comparisons.
The LLL cold rejection adds roughly10–43us to repeated calls (2.8–15.3% in this corpus); a genuine cold-admission proof and reduced proof overhead remain work.

performance.status: Three paired integrated release campaigns completed; all raw cases and regressions retained.
